summary: Lynn, Green, Zahedi & Apelian 2023 (Am J Clin Hypn 65(3):186-210): extends Kirsch response expectancy into integrative model encompassing predictive coding. Modern non-state theory converging with predictive-processing frameworks.
content: Lynn, Green, Zahedi & Apelian 2023, 'The response set theory of hypnosis reconsidered: toward an integrative model,' American Journal of Clinical Hypnosis 65(3):186-210. Honors Kirsch; extends response expectancy theory into an integrative model encompassing predictive coding. Focus: (I) how response set theory can be conceptualized in terms of the predictive coding model and (II) psycho-social constructs needed to better understand effects of expectancies on hypnotic phenomena in an open, evidence-based integrative model. KEY signal: the leading modern non-state theory is being reframed within predictive coding, which is also being used by state-friendly/neurocognitive theorists — convergence rather than dichotomy.
